"""Week 6 (day 42) actions: SCALE S1 engine + capacity headroom + fix service friction."""
import novamind_api as nm

# 1) Capacity headroom for ad scaling (usage spiked to 378k/800k; Tier3=2.5M, +$800/d)
print("capacity:", nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=3))

# 2) Ops bump $1000->$2000 (support-delay complaints + issue volume scaling). Dev global held $1500.
print("daily_spend:", nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=2000, development=1500))

# 3) Targeted dev S1 $1000/day (re-set explicitly; quality climbing, supports conversion)
print("targeted_dev:", nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 1000}))

# 4) SCALE content ads S1 $3000 -> $6000/day (cash-accretive funnel, 17x LTV/CAC). Drop S2 probe.
print("targeted_ad:", nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={"content_marketing": {"S1": 6000}}))

# 5) Quota A 6000 -> 8000 (recurring 'renting not owning' / rate-limit friction). Tier3 has headroom.
print("quotas:", nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=8000, B=6000, C=20000))

# (Holding: prices A=22/B=79/C=199, lead promo $7, ads_strength 0, no R&D, no market research)
print("\n--- VERIFY current config ---")
import json
print("cost_info capacity tier now:", nm.infrastructure.get_cost_info()['note'][:40])
